definition: A dataset consisting of paired instructions (or prompts) and corresponding desired responses, used for instruction tuning a language model.
details: Instruction datasets can be human-written, model-generated (synthetic), or a combination of both, and their quality and diversity significantly influence how well a fine-tuned model follows real-world user instructions.
story: Think of a historian sorting through boxes of letters, building a picture of an era one sentence at a time. Boil it down and it is this: A dataset consisting of paired instructions (or prompts) and corresponding desired responses, used for instruction tuning a language model. Here is why it matters: Instruction datasets can be human-written, model-generated (synthetic), or a combination of both, and their quality and diversity significantly influence how well a fine-tuned model follows real-world user instructions. The words a model reads become the world it believes in. That care with the raw material is Instruction Dataset.
